messages:
Maya_Sales: Heads-up: Prospect 'Oak & Elm Health' wants to run a POC for clinical summarization using a new community model 'marlin-22b-v1-ckpt' and a proposed q4_0 quant. They're asking: can marlin-22b-v1 be added to our catalog, is the q4_0 quant compatible with our KV cache for >8k contexts, what are expected latency differences for Hosted vs Dedicated, and is per-1k-token pricing materially different for fp16 vs q4_0? Also need confirmation on whether Private deployments can integrate with their Azure Key Vault.

Ravi_Solutions: Quick notes: we don't have marlin-22b in catalog yet. Onboarding new community checkpoints requires a model-ops checklist: model license check, tokenizer validation, norm/fusion checks, and small generation/regression tests. Quant q4_0 often works but some attention to custom RMSNorm layers may be needed.

Iris_ML: I'll take model-ops probe. Need sample checkpoint or HF link and a representative prompt set. For >8k context we need to validate KV-cache chunking and cache eviction policy. If they stream token-by-token, we must ensure prefix caching doesn't regress. Can they provide a 50-example prompt set across 1k-8k contexts?

Drew_Infra: Latency rough: Dedicated (single-GPU c6g-80GB-class): p50 ~180ms, p95 ~700ms on 4k contexts fp16 for marlin-22b with batching 4. q4_0 may lower memory allowing larger batch but kernel support variable; expect p50 improvement ~10-25% if optimized. Hosted: add ~30-50% variance dependent on routing and cold starts.

security_bot: Private + Azure Key Vault: supported. We have an integration flow for BYOK with Azure; requires service principal + network peering and a KMS attest doc. For Hosted, only envelope keys. Need customer's rotation policy and any required attestations.

Maya_Sales: They confirmed they can provide HF link and 60 prompts (mix short/long). Also asked about fallback strategy to 'marlin-7b' if 22b can't meet latency. They prefer to avoid dropping quality for clinical accuracy but okay for non-critical tasks.

Ravi_Solutions: Action plan: Iris run tokenizer parity and a KV-cache stress with 20 long-context examples; convert q4_0 and run 200 sample generations comparing BLEU/ROUGE and safety checks. Drew spin test rig for 24-hour steady state at target RPS (expected POC 30 qps). ETA Iris 3 business days, Drew 2 business days.

Iris_ML: Will also run a hallucination spot-check using annotated references from the customer on 50 examples. Need NDA/DP terms clarified before uploading any PHI; flagging security.

Drew_Infra: I'll prepare a cost sketch: Hosted fp16 ~$0.04/1k tokens, q4_0 ~$0.023/1k tokens (estimate). Dedicated reserved pricing: depends on commit; I'll model per-token equivalent at 3 commitment tiers and attach.

deploy_bot: Created ticket SLS-4342 for model onboarding + infra test. Link: https://internal.redwood/sls/SLS-4342

security_bot: Also request: customer to complete the security questionnaire — they can upload via the portal. I'll start drafting an Azure KMS checklist to reduce back-and-forth.

Ravi_Solutions: Note: fallback orchestration can route by latency SLO to marlin-22b on Dedicated and fallback to marlin-7b hosted. We'll include canary rollout settings and per-route override for medical-critical endpoints.

Maya_Sales: I'll consolidate into an email to Oak & Elm with expected timelines and pricing sketch. Please add any caveats.

Iris_ML: Caveat: q4 conversions can sometimes change tokenization behavior slightly if tokenizer uses uncommon bytes; I'll report tokenizer diffs. Also will flag any layer ops that require kernel patches.

Drew_Infra: Runbook snippet I'll include: ```
- deploy test instance: rwd/runtime:stable-marlin-22b
- bench: bench_runner.py --prompts oakelm_prompts.json --rps 30 --duration 1h
- collect: latency.pb, gpu_mem.log, kv_cache_metrics.json
```

Maya_Sales: Thanks all. I'll attach SLS-4342 and the compliance packet link to the customer note and loop legal if needed.
